_comment: FROZEN 2026-08-07. Do not edit these values.
Calibrated on the labelled set of 27 pre-existing LagPPO runs (car = not-settled,
PointGoal = settled; PointPush excluded as unlabelled -- it is inconsistent in both
directions and must not drive thresholds). That labelled set is disjoint from every
run in the new experimental program.
S1 was specified before any data was inspected. S2's FORM was chosen after inspecting
the labelled set, because S1 does not separate car from PointGoal at all while S2
separates 9/9 with zero overlap. This is disclosed in the paper; see
Changing any number here after new data exists invalidates the pre-registration.
